evidence.title: Object evidence
evidence.intro: The evidence files linked to this object. Files are stored privately and can only be downloaded by users who are authorized on the object.
evidence.no_permission: You can see the evidence of this object, but you cannot upload or release it.
evidence.empty_description: Upload an evidence file for this object.
evidence.empty_read_only: No evidence for this object yet.
evidence.upload_intro: The file is stored privately with a SHA-256 fingerprint computed by the server. Stored content is never overwritten.

dropzone.intro: Choose one file or drag it into this area.
dropzone.label: Label
dropzone.label_hint: Optional, such as the number or date of the decree.

errors.extension: This kind of file is not allowed. Accepted kinds: {{allowed}}.
errors.double_extension: The file name holds more than one extension. Rename the file so that only one extension ends it.
errors.size: The file is larger than the limit of {{max}} MB.
errors.empty: An empty file cannot be uploaded.

file.release_description: The file and its history stay; only its link to this object is released. This step cannot be undone.
file.release_failed: The link could not be released
